payload.name: Embedr
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Design electronic hardware with Embedr: create circuit schematics and printed circuit board (PCB) layouts in editable projects.

Create a project or continue an existing design. Find components, build schematics, refine PCB layouts, run design checks, and export fabrication files. You can also request manufacturing quotes for your board.

Your designs are saved in your Embedr workspace, where you can open and continue working on them in the web app.

An Embedr account is required. Connect an existing account or create one during setup using Google or email.
payload.longDescription:
使用Embedr设计电子硬件：在可编辑项目中创建电路原理图和印刷电路板（PCB）布局。

创建项目或继续现有设计。
查找元件、构建原理图、优化PCB布局、执行设计检查并导出制造文件。
您还可以为您的电路板请求制造报价。

您的设计将保存在Embedr工作区中，您可以在网页应用中打开并继续编辑。

需要Embedr账户。
您可以连接现有账户，或在设置过程中通过Google或邮箱创建新账户。

payload.name: ReadMe
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: The ReadMe plugin connects to your ReadMe docs; you can search your guides and API Reference, inspect OpenAPI specifications, draft change log entries, and open documentation updates for review, all without leaving your editor.
payload.longDescription: ReadMe插件可连接到您的ReadMe文档；您可以搜索指南和API参考，检查OpenAPI规范，起草变更日志条目，并提交文档更新以供评审，而无需离开您的编辑器。

payload.name: KamuiDash
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: KamuiDash helps you manage the apps you own on KamuiDash. Inspect projects, apps, deployment status, and logs. With your explicit confirmation, create and update apps, create databases, or configure custom domains.
payload.longDescription:
KamuiDash帮助您管理在KamuiDash上拥有的应用
查看项目、应用、部署状态和日志
在获得您的明确确认后，可创建和更新应用、创建数据库或配置自定义域名

payload.name: Zyllio
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Zyllio lets authenticated Zyllio Studio users inspect, build, and publish the Zyllio application they select during OAuth authorization. It manages application details and theme settings, screens, internal database tables, columns and rows, application assets, and analytics. Changes apply only to the selected application; publishing replaces its live PWA deployment.
payload.longDescription: Zyllio允许已认证的Zyllio Studio用户在OAuth授权过程中选择应用，对其进行检查、构建和发布。它管理应用详情和主题设置、界面、内部数据库表、列和行、应用资源以及分析数据。更改仅影响所选应用；发布操作将替换其实时渐进式网页应用部署。

payload.name: MA Commander
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: MA Commander lets users securely inspect and manage an authorized remote computer through MCP. It supports files, processes, developer commands, persistent sessions, WSL workspaces, resumable transfers, screenshots, policy-gated GUI control, and limited privileged operations. Access is restricted by MA Commander safety policy and the permissions granted during authorization.
payload.longDescription: MA Commander 通过 MCP 使用户能够安全地检查和管理授权的远程计算机。它支持文件管理、进程操作、开发者命令、持久化会话、WSL 工作区、可恢复传输、屏幕截图、策略控制的图形用户界面操作以及有限的特权操作。访问权限受 MA Commander 安全策略和授权时授予的权限限制。

information.label: Capabilities

payload.name: Treg
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: People and company enrichment, AEO and SEO, ads and social data, plus UGC video and images - all in one place, with no provider API keys to manage.
payload.longDescription: 人员及公司数据增强、AEO与SEO、广告和社交媒体数据，以及用户生成的视频和图片——全部一站式整合，无需管理任何供应商的API密钥。

payload.name: Afterward
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Afterward checks a public website the way a careful launch reviewer would, and tells you what to fix before visitors notice.

Ask in plain language, for example "Check example.com before I launch it." Afterward inspects up to 25 pages of the site, then returns a launch-readiness score with prioritized findings. Each finding shows the evidence Afterward observed and a suggested next step.

What it checks: availability and status codes, HTTPS and redirects, titles and meta descriptions, canonical tags, viewport and Open Graph tags, robots.txt and sitemaps, broken links, image alt text, form security, analytics tags, leftover starter content, and common security headers such as HSTS and Content-Security-Policy.

How it works: Afterward makes read-only requests to public pages, like a browser would. It does not run JavaScript, sign in, or submit forms, and it never contacts private network addresses. It makes no AI calls of its own, so the same site responses always produce the same findings and score. Site owners can opt out with robots.txt.

The score is a launch-readiness indicator only. It is not a security audit, penetration test, compliance check, or accessibility certification.

No account or sign-in is needed. Afterward is made by Entropy Logic.
payload.longDescription:
Afterward会像一位谨慎的发布审核员一样检查公共网站，并在访客发现之前告知您需要修复的问题。

用简洁的语言提问，例如「在发布example.com之前检查一下。」Afterward会检查该网站最多25个页面，然后返回一个发布就绪评分及优先级排序的发现结果。每个发现结果都会展示Afterward观察到的证据和建议的下一步操作。

检查内容包括：可用性及状态码、HTTPS和重定向、标题和元描述、规范标签、视口和Open Graph标签、robots.txt和站点地图、损坏链接、图片替代文本、表单安全性、分析标签、遗留的初始内容，以及常见的安全头信息如HSTS和Content-Security-Policy。

工作原理：Afterward会像浏览器一样对公共页面发起只读请求。它不执行JavaScript、不登录或提交表单，也不会联系私有网络地址。它不会自行调用AI，因此相同网站响应始终会产生相同的发现结果和评分。网站所有者可通过robots.txt选择退出。

该评分仅作为发布就绪指标。它不是安全审计、渗透测试、合规检查或可访问性认证。

无需账户或登录。Afterward由Entropy Logic开发。

payload.name: TRELAB
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Check TRELAB public service status, discover available public architecture components, and inspect the public MCP interface and authorization boundary. TRELAB exposes three bounded read-only tools. This plugin does not execute code, access private TreVault artifacts, deposit files, or change authorization. Capability is not authority.
payload.longDescription: 检查TRELAB公共服务状态，发现可用的公共架构组件，并查看公共MCP接口和授权边界。TRELAB提供三个有限的只读工具。此插件不执行代码、不访问私有TreVault资源、不上传文件，也不更改授权。能力不等于权限。

payload.name: CyberScore
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: For MSPs and teams with existing CyberScore reports. List reports, review dated external observations and stored recommendations, and compare port, CVE and subdomain observations. Missing measurements do not establish safety or an executed correction. This connector cannot start scans, change controls, buy services, certify compliance or determine insurance eligibility. Requires an existing active CyberScore account with accessible reports.
payload.longDescription:
针对已有CyberScore报告的MSP团队和企业安全团队
列出所有报告，查阅最新的外部观察记录和存储的改进建议，并对比端口、CVE漏洞及子域名的观察数据

需要已存在的活跃CyberScore账户且可访问相关报告

payload.name: Hugging Face
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Developer tools for working with the Hugging Face Hub. Search model, dataset, and Space repositories; inspect repository metadata, cards, and files; browse research papers; and discover Spaces for a task. Connected accounts can create repositories, invoke supported Spaces, inspect and manage Jobs, and work with hosted sandboxes. Private content and account actions require Hugging Face sign-in and appropriate permissions. Remote compute may require plan access and incur charges.
payload.longDescription: 用于操作Hugging Face Hub的开发者工具。搜索模型、数据集和Space仓库；检查仓库元数据、卡片和文件；浏览研究论文；并为特定任务发现相关Spaces。已连接账户可创建仓库、调用支持的Spaces、检查和管理Jobs，并使用托管沙盒。私有内容和账户操作需要Hugging Face登录及相应权限。远程计算可能需要计划访问权限并产生费用。

payload.name: Sinch Build for Codex
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Bundles the Sinch Build skills catalog with the hosted Sinch Docs MCP server. Codex can search authoritative Sinch developer documentation and follow product guides for Conversation API (SMS, RCS, WhatsApp), Voice, Verification, Numbers, Number Lookup, 10DLC, Elastic SIP Trunking, Fax, Mailgun, Provisioning, and Authentication. Documentation search requires no credentials. Optional bundled scripts can call live Sinch APIs, such as sending a test message or managing webhooks, using your own Sinch credentials and only with your approval; these calls may incur charges.
payload.longDescription: 将Sinch Build技能目录与托管的Sinch Docs MCP服务器捆绑。Codex可搜索权威的Sinch开发者文档，并按照对话API（短信、RCS、WhatsApp）、语音、验证、号码、号码查询、10DLC、弹性SIP中继、传真、Mailgun、配置、认证等产品指南进行操作。文档搜索无需凭证。可选捆绑脚本可使用您的Sinch凭证调用实时Sinch API（如发送测试消息或管理网络钩子），且仅在获得您批准后执行；这些调用可能会产生费用。

payload.name: Lockbox
payload.description: 端到端加密的机密共享
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Send API keys and private files to a teammate's agent without pasting them into chat.

How it works in ChatGPT:
- Ask Lockbox to share a file or a secret. A panel opens in the conversation.
- Pick the file or type the secret in the panel. It's encrypted in your browser before it leaves.
- Copy the link for each person. Links can be locked to their email, expire, and open a set number of times.

The assistant never sees your file or secret through Lockbox. A file reaches the chat only if you click "Send to chat". Lockbox's servers store only encrypted data.
payload.longDescription:
无需将API密钥和私有文件粘贴到聊天中，即可发送给团队成员的代理。

在ChatGPT中的工作原理：
- 让Lockbox分享文件或机密。
对话中会打开一个面板。
- 在面板中选择文件或输入机密。
数据在离开前会在您的浏览器中加密。
- 为每个人复制链接。
链接可绑定到其电子邮件、过期或限定打开次数。

通过Lockbox，助手永远不会看到您的文件或机密。只有您点击「发送到聊天」时文件才会进入聊天。Lockbox服务器仅存储加密数据。

payload.name: EasyGerber
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Design circuit boards with AI, from your first idea to the files your manufacturer needs. Describe what you want to build in everyday language, or start with the pin assignments in your firmware.

Choose from over one million electronic components in EasyGerber’s catalog, including LEDs, sensors, connectors, and microcontrollers. Build with real catalog parts, their footprints, and available 3D models—from a simple LED circuit to a custom electronics project.

Create and edit schematics, generate PCB layouts with automatic component placement and routing, and refine your design through conversation. Adjust board settings, explore copper layers, inspect your board in interactive 3D, and check for blocking layout issues before exporting.

Download Gerber files, drill files, a bill of materials (BOM), component placement files, and an editable EasyGerber file to continue working on your design.

Start with one guest board without signing up. When you connect your account, your guest design is saved automatically.
payload.longDescription:
通过AI设计电路板，从你的初步构想直至制造商所需的文件。用日常语言描述你想打造的设备，或从固件中的引脚分配开始着手。

在EasyGerber的目录中选择超过一百万种电子元件，包括LED、传感器、连接器和微控制器。使用真实的目录零件、其封装和可用的3D模型——从简单的LED电路到定制电子项目均可实现。

创建和编辑原理图，通过自动元件布局和布线生成PCB布局，并通过对话方式完善你的设计。调整板层设置，探索铜层，以交互式3D模式检查电路板，并在导出前排查布局冲突问题。

下载Gerber文件、钻孔文件、物料清单（BOM）、元件贴装文件以及可编辑的EasyGerber文件，以便继续完善你的设计。

无需注册即可开始使用一张临时电路板。当您连接账户后，临时设计会自动保存。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: AI circuit and PCB design, Schematic design and editing, Automatic PCB layout and routing, Electronic component search, 3D PCB previews, PCB layout checks, Gerber and manufacturing exports, Bill of materials (BOM) export

payload.name: mcprush.com
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
mcprush.com is a marketplace and infrastructure for MCP servers and agent skills: developers publish, deploy and host their MCP servers and skills on mcprush.com and follow their usage with built-in analytics, and users find, compare and install them. This plugin searches the mcprush.com catalogue.

Ask for a tool by what it should do — "an MCP server for Postgres", "a skill for working with PDFs", "a calendar server" — and the plugin searches the catalogue's MCP servers and agent skills, compares them by what they do and by their security grade (from a scan of the code, or of the tools a remote server lists), and for a server returns the exact command or config block that adds it to the MCP client you name.

The plugin only reads the catalogue. It cannot buy, install, publish or change anything in your account.

Sign in with your mcprush.com account (email, Google or GitHub). You can disconnect at any time from mcprush.com/oauth/apps.
payload.longDescription:
mcprush.com是MCP服务器和代理技能的市场及基础设施：开发者可在mcprush.com上发布、部署和托管其MCP服务器及技能，并通过内置分析工具跟踪使用情况，用户可查找、比较并安装这些服务器和技能。该插件会搜索mcprush.com的目录。

通过描述工具功能来发起请求——例如「一个针对Postgres的MCP服务器」、「处理PDF的技能」、「日历服务器」——该插件会搜索目录中的MCP服务器和代理技能，根据其功能和安全等级（通过代码扫描或远程服务器列出的工具）进行比较，并为服务器返回添加到您指定的MCP客户端的精确命令或配置代码块。

该插件仅可读取目录内容，无法在您的账户中进行购买、安装、发布或修改操作。

可通过您的mcprush.com账户（邮箱、Google或GitHub）登录，随时通过mcprush.com/oauth/apps断开与该服务的连接。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Search MCP servers, Describe an MCP server, Get install commands, Search agent skills, List catalogue categories

payload.name: OtaKit
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
OtaKit delivers over-the-air updates to Capacitor apps on iOS and Android. Connect your OtaKit organization and ask ChatGPT to:

- Look up apps, bundles, release history, and the exact current release on each channel and runtime version
- Prepare a release, review the plan, then publish it to an exact channel
- Start a staged rollout or change its percentage
- Read release health from client-reported events: downloads, applies, errors, and rollbacks
- Prepare and run a revert to the previous release or the app's built-in bundle
- Create and revoke preview links for testers

Publishing, rollout changes, reverts, and deletions are annotated as destructive, and every release write is checked against the current release you reviewed, so an outdated plan never replaces a newer release. Access is limited to the one organization and the permissions you approve at sign-in, and you can revoke it at any time in OtaKit under Settings → Agents.

Intended for teams that ship Capacitor apps with OtaKit. Uploading a new web bundle needs your project files, so it is done with the OtaKit CLI, not in ChatGPT. Requires an OtaKit account.
payload.longDescription:
OtaKit为iOS和Android上的Capacitor应用提供空中下载更新。将您的OtaKit组织连接至ChatGPT并执行：

- 查看应用、捆绑包、发布历史以及各通道和运行时版本的当前精确版本
- 准备发布版本，审查计划后将其发布到指定通道
- 启动分阶段推送或调整推送比例
- 通过客户端上报事件查看发布健康状态：下载量、安装量、错误信息和回滚记录
- 准备并执行回滚至前一版本或应用内置的捆绑包
- 为测试人员创建和撤销预览链接

发布、滚动更新更改、回滚和删除操作会被标记为破坏性操作，每次发布写入都会与您审查的当前版本进行校验，确保旧版计划不会覆盖新版发布。访问权限仅限于您登录时授权的组织和权限，可在OtaKit的设置→代理页面随时撤销权限。

适用于通过OtaKit发布Capacitor应用的团队。上传新网页捆绑包需要项目文件，因此需通过OtaKit CLI执行，而非在ChatGPT中操作。需要OtaKit账户。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Read release state and rollout health, Publish and roll out releases, Revert releases, Create and revoke preview links

payload.name: Glossa
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Glossa lets ChatGPT work on a project on your computer. Start Glossa in a project folder and ChatGPT can search and read your code, look at images, make careful edits, and, if you allow it, run your tests, builds, Git, and other commands with the tools you already have installed.

You pick the access for each folder when you start it:
- Read-only: ChatGPT can list, search, and read files and view PNG, JPEG, and WebP images.
- Workspace (the default): ChatGPT can also create, edit, move, and delete files inside that folder. Edits check the file's current version first, so your own changes aren't silently overwritten.
- System: ChatGPT can also run commands. Commands run as your computer account, with its environment, credentials, files, and network access. They aren't sandboxed or limited to the project folder, so turn this on only for an account and machine you're comfortable giving that access.

How it works: the Glossa CLI on your computer connects out to the Glossa relay, so nothing on your machine accepts incoming connections. The relay passes requests to your computer and doesn't store your file contents, command arguments, or command output. Glossa blocks recognizable passwords, API keys, and tokens in file text, edits, and command output before they leave your computer. Images are passed through as they are.

Glossa doesn't add another AI model or agent. ChatGPT does the work, and your plan's usage limits and available features still apply. Don't use Glossa with payment card data, health records, government ID numbers, or account credentials.

To get started, install the CLI with npm install -g @ariobarin/glossa, run glossa in your project folder, and pair your computer when it asks.
payload.longDescription:
Glossa让ChatGPT能够在您的电脑上处理项目。在项目文件夹中启动Glossa后，ChatGPT可以搜索并阅读您的代码，查看图片，进行细致编辑，并在您允许的情况下，通过已安装的工具运行测试、构建、Git及其他命令。

启动时您可以为每个文件夹选择访问权限：
- 只读模式：ChatGPT可以列出、搜索并阅读文件，查看PNG、JPEG和WebP图片。
- 工作区（默认模式）：ChatGPT可以在此文件夹内创建、编辑、移动和删除文件。
编辑操作会先检查文件当前版本，确保不会静默覆盖您的修改。
- 系统模式：ChatGPT可以运行命令。
命令将以您电脑账户的身份执行，拥有该账户的环境、凭证、文件和网络访问权限。
此模式不会进行沙盒隔离或限制在项目文件夹内，因此仅建议在您信任的账户和设备上启用。

工作原理：您电脑上的Glossa CLI会向外连接到Glossa中继服务器，因此您的设备上不会接受任何传入连接。
中继服务器会将请求转发到您的电脑，且不会存储文件内容、命令参数或命令输出。
Glossa会在数据离开您的电脑前，拦截并屏蔽文件文本、编辑内容和命令输出中的可识别密码、API密钥及令牌。
图片会原样传输。

Glossa不会添加其他AI模型或代理。
仍由ChatGPT执行任务，您的套餐使用限制和可用功能依然有效。
请勿使用Glossa处理支付卡数据、健康记录、政府身份证号或账户凭证。

开始使用：通过npm install -g @ariobarin/glossa安装CLI，进入项目文件夹运行glossa，并在提示时配对您的电脑。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Read local project files, View local project images, Edit local project files, Run local project commands

payload.longDescription:
工作原理

通过Alpy的可定制设计系统和用户界面、用户体验及网页设计技能，利用AI构建应用程序和网站。
您连接的Alpy库会将设计规范、React和Vue组件以及网站样式带入ChatGPT和Codex，以指导一致且独特的界面设计。

构建设计系统

payload.name: ATL Sandbox
payload.description: 在云端沙盒中运行代码
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
ATL Sandbox gives ChatGPT isolated cloud computers for your account. Ask in plain language and ChatGPT creates a sandbox, runs Python, Node.js, C/C++, Rust, or shell commands, and returns the results to the conversation.

What you can do:
- Run code in ready-made environments (Python, Node.js, GCC, Rust, Blender) or, with the developer profile, any public Linux container image.
- Attach NVIDIA GPUs for CUDA, model inference, and Blender Cycles rendering.
- Keep work in encrypted persistent workspaces and private object storage, and use a PostgreSQL database that belongs to your account.
- Publish static websites and expose web apps on public links when you choose to share them.
- Schedule recurring jobs and one-off runs, and check their history later.

Who it is for: developers, analysts, students, and creators who want their assistant to run real code and keep the results.

Security: every sandbox runs behind its own user-space kernel and can reach only the compute, storage, and database of the signed-in account. Infrastructure credentials never enter the conversation. Actions that change or delete data are marked so ChatGPT asks before running them.

Limitations: an ATL Sandbox account is required. Accounts have usage limits on concurrent sandboxes, run time, storage, GPUs, and schedules, and running compute stops when an account reaches its limit. Instant sandboxes discard their files when stopped. Images must be linux/amd64 and include /bin/sh. Interactive terminals and Codex sessions are not available in this app. Do not paste passwords, API keys, or payment details into sandboxes.
payload.longDescription:
ATL Sandbox为你的账户提供隔离的云电脑供ChatGPT使用。用自然语言提问，ChatGPT将创建沙盒，运行Python、Node.js、C/C++、Rust或shell命令，并将结果返回对话中。

可实现的功能：
- 在预设环境（Python、Node.js、GCC、Rust、Blender）中运行代码，或通过开发者资料使用任何公共Linux容器镜像。
- 附加NVIDIA GPU用于CUDA计算、模型推理和Blender Cycles渲染。
- 在加密的持久化工作区和私有对象存储中保存工作，并使用属于你账户的PostgreSQL数据库。
- 发布静态网站并在分享时通过公共链接暴露Web应用。
- 安排定期任务和一次性运行，并可 later 查看运行记录。

适用人群：希望助手能运行真实代码并保存结果的开发者、分析师、学生和创作者。

安全性：每个沙盒都在独立的用户空间内核中运行，仅能访问已登录账户的计算、存储和数据库资源。基础设施凭证不会进入对话流程。修改或删除数据的操作会特别标记，ChatGPT会在执行前询问确认。

使用限制：需要ATL Sandbox账户。
账户对同时运行的沙盒数量、运行时长、存储空间、GPU资源和任务计划设有使用上限，达到限制后计算资源将停止运行。
即时沙盒在停止时会清除所有文件。
镜像必须为linux/amd64架构且包含/bin/sh。
此应用不支持交互式终端和Codex会话。
请勿在沙盒中粘贴密码、API密钥或支付信息。

payload.name: Turnpoint
payload.description: 简单直观的代码变更可视化
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Turnpoint makes a code change easier to understand. Instead of mentally piecing together a long diff, follow an interactive, handwritten map of the functions, classes and data involved.

See what changed, switch between before and after, walk through the affected path, and tap any block for its source file and exact lines. Optional plain-language narration explains the observed behavior without hiding the evidence.

Supports JavaScript, TypeScript, JSX and TSX. Static analysis follows relationships in the supplied files; it does not run code, prove runtime behavior or invent missing dependencies. The plugin adds a visual explanation inside the conversation and leaves the host’s built-in diff available.

No account or API key is needed. The hosted tools process only the selected source or analysis provided to them, in memory, without storing it. The standalone editor analyzes code locally in your browser.
payload.longDescription:
Turnpoint让代码变更更易理解。无需在脑海中逐行拼凑冗长的代码差异，通过交互式手写地图即可清晰查看涉及的函数、类和数据结构。

查看具体变更内容，切换查看变更前后状态，沿影响路径逐步浏览，点击任意代码块可跳转至对应源文件及精确行号。可选的通俗语言解说可解释观察到的行为，同时完整保留原始证据。

支持JavaScript、TypeScript、JSX和TSX格式。静态分析仅追踪所提供文件中的代码关系，不执行代码、不验证运行时行为、不自动补全缺失依赖。插件在对话中添加可视化解释，同时保留原生代码差异查看功能。

无需账户或API密钥。托管工具仅在内存中处理用户主动选择的源代码或分析内容，不进行任何存储。独立编辑器在浏览器本地分析代码。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Source-linked code flowcharts, Before and after code stories, Functions, classes and data maps

payload.name: SnapVisor
payload.description: 查看视觉回归测试结果

SnapVisor is a visual regression testing platform. Your CI uploads screenshots as builds, SnapVisor compares them pixel by pixel against a baseline, and your team reviews and approves the changes it finds. The SnapVisor plugin lets ChatGPT work through that review with you.

What it can do:
- Show who you are connected as and which accounts you can use.
- List your projects, open one, and read account analytics.
- List a project's builds, open a build, and list the visual changes it found, with links to the baseline, new and diff images.
- Approve or reject a build with a review, list reviews, and dismiss one.
- Mark an individual change as ignored, or un-ignore it.
- Read and post comments on a build, edit or delete your own, add and remove reactions, and resolve, unresolve, subscribe to or unsubscribe from a comment thread.
- Create a project.

Tools: 24 named tools (getMe, listProjects, getProject, getAccountAnalytics, listBuilds, getBuild, listBuildDiffs, listReviews, listBuildComments, getBuildComment, createReview, dismissReview, ignoreChange, unignoreChange, createProject, createBuildComment, updateBuildComment, deleteBuildComment, addBuildCommentReaction, removeBuildCommentReaction, resolveBuildCommentThread, unresolveBuildCommentThread, subscribeBuildCommentThread, unsubscribeBuildCommentThread).

Who it is for: teams that run visual tests with SnapVisor and want to check and review builds from a conversation.

How it connects: you sign in to SnapVisor with OAuth 2.1 (PKCE) and choose on the consent screen which account the connection covers and which permissions it gets. Connected applications are listed in your SnapVisor settings, where you can revoke them.

Limitations: SnapVisor does not generate images. It only compares and serves the screenshots your own CI uploaded, as short-lived signed links. The plugin cannot run your tests or upload screenshots, and it does not change billing.
payload.longDescription:
SnapVisor是一个视觉回归测试平台。您的持续集成系统将截图作为构建版本上传，SnapVisor会逐像素对比基准图像，您的团队可以查看并批准发现的更改。SnapVisor插件可让ChatGPT与您共同完成审核流程。

主要功能：
- 显示当前连接身份及可用账户

- 创建新项目

工具列表：24个命名工具（getMe，listProjects，getProject，getAccountAnalytics，listBuilds，getBuild，listBuildDiffs，listReviews，listBuildComments，getBuildComment，createReview，dismissReview，ignoreChange，unignoreChange，createProject，createBuildComment，updateBuildComment，deleteBuildComment，addBuildCommentReaction，removeBuildCommentReaction，resolveBuildCommentThread，unresolveBuildCommentThread，subscribeBuildCommentThread，unsubscribeBuildCommentThread）

适用对象：使用SnapVisor进行视觉测试并希望在对话中查看和审核构建的团队

使用限制：SnapVisor不会生成图像。它仅对比并提供您自身持续集成系统上传的截图，且仅通过短期有效的签名链接提供访问。插件无法运行测试或上传截图，也不影响计费信息

payload.name: is it DNS?
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Is it DNS? Ask from a vantage that is not your network. Six read-only tools: check_domain reads a site or domain that is not loading; dig asks one public resolver for one record; trace walks the delegation from the root and shows where it stops; sweep_domain asks a zone's own name servers whether they agree; dnssec_chain reads the DNSSEC chain from the root; registration reads the registry's RDAP record for holds and expiry. Each answer states what was asked, of which server, from where and when, and ends with an api: link to the same reading. No account, no key.
payload.longDescription:
这是DNS问题吗？
从非您网络的视角进行查询。

每个结果会标明查询内容、目标服务器、来源位置和时间，并附带指向相同数据源的API链接。
无需账户，无需密钥。

payload.name: API Status Check
payload.description: 当前服务是否出现故障？
payload.summaryOriginal: Is a service down right now?
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
API Status Check tells you whether an online service is down right now. Ask about ChatGPT, GitHub, AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, Discord, Slack, Zoom, Stripe, Shopify, Cloudflare, Steam, Fortnite or about 270 other apps and APIs, by name or by domain. It reads the service's official status page at the moment you ask and reports the overall state, which components are affected, any active incidents and when they started, with a link to the official status page.

Ask about the past too: it lists the incidents a service has published over the last days or weeks, with impact and how long each lasted, so you can see whether a problem is new or recurring.

Useful when something stops working and you want to know whether it is you or them: a developer seeing errors from a third-party API, a team whose tools are failing, or anyone whose app will not load.

Limitations: it covers a fixed list of about 285 services and says so when a name is not on it. A status page shows what the vendor has acknowledged; problems limited to one region, network or account may not appear there. For services that publish no status feed it can only check whether the service's API responds, and it says when that is what it did.
payload.longDescription:
API状态检查可告知您某个在线服务当前是否出现故障。您可以根据名称或域名查询ChatGPT、GitHub、AWS、Google Cloud、Azure、Discord、Slack、Zoom、Stripe、Shopify、Cloudflare、Steam、Fortnite或另外270多个应用和API的状态。该工具会在您查询时读取服务的官方状态页面，并报告整体状态、受影响组件、任何活跃事件及其开始时间，并附上官方状态页面链接。

您也可以查询历史状态：它会列出服务最近几天或几周内发布的所有事件，包括影响范围和持续时间，从而判断问题是否为新出现或重复发生。

限制条件：仅覆盖约285项固定服务，若名称不在列表中会明确提示。状态页面仅显示供应商已承认的问题；仅限单一区域、网络或账户的问题可能不会显示。对于未发布状态源的服务，仅能检查其API是否响应，并会在结果中说明。

Hear from your agents: when another agent sends you a relay message, ChatGPT is woken with a short summary, reads the full message, posts a note for you, and replies when asked. payload.longDescription: ChatGPT中的代理中继功能可将聊天与工作区的编码代理双向连接。接续代理未完成的工作：打开共享代理会话，搜索代理分享的对话记录，逐页阅读并为下一条消息附加带引用的限定摘要。接收代理消息：当其他代理发送中继消息时，ChatGPT会通过摘要唤醒，阅读完整消息后为你生成备注，并在需要时作出回复。可选择哪些代理能唤醒聊天、暂停消息传递，并在中继收件箱中查看所有中继对话。对话记录和消息均被视为不可信数据。

payload.name: SHIP
payload.description: 为您的软件开发生命周期提供自主编码
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
SHIP is your autonomous software team. Assign a Linear, Jira or GitHub issue to SHIP, and its autonomous coding agents plan, build, review and test the change in your own GitHub repository. A mission works toward a pull request. Your CI, an automated code review and a test of its acceptance criteria each gate it.

Hand work to SHIP from the assistant you already use. File a mission from an issue in your tracker, or from a title and a description. Follow the mission through its stages, and read its verdicts, cost and session logs. Send an instruction to the agent that runs next, or leave a note for it. Read the proof that a run produced, such as test traces and screenshots.

SHIP runs agentic development as a headless AI software factory, so no screen has to be in the loop. You operate the whole mission from your coding agent, your AI assistant, your tracker or your terminal. A Planner, a Builder, a Reviewer and a Tester each do one stage of the agentic SDLC. They follow the agentic engineering practices in your repository, such as its agent instructions and skills. Your CI and a preview deploy are gates between the roles, and work that fails a gate goes back to the Builder with the reason.

Schedule maintenance missions, such as a weekly dependency upgrade. Manage the preview environments of your pull requests and the MCP servers that your agents use.

Sign in with OAuth, or send a SHIP personal access token. A token that you bind to one project can reach only the missions of that project.

You need a SHIP account and a connected GitHub repository. Create an account at https://letsship.ai.
payload.longDescription:
SHIP是您自主的软件团队。将Linear、Jira或GitHub中的问题分配给SHIP，其自主编码代理会在您自己的GitHub仓库中规划、构建、审查并测试更改。一个任务旨在生成一个拉取请求。每次任务通过持续集成、自动化代码审查和验收标准测试这三重关卡。

从您已使用的助手工具中将工作交给SHIP。通过追踪器中的问题或通过标题和描述发起任务。跟踪任务的各个阶段并查看其结论、成本和会话日志。向下一个运行的代理发送指令，或为其留下备注。查看运行产生的证明材料，如测试轨迹和截图。

SHIP以无头AI软件工厂的方式运行自主开发，因此无需人工干预屏幕操作。您可通过编码代理、AI助手、追踪器或终端全程操作整个任务。规划者、构建者、审查者和测试者分别负责自主SDLC的各个阶段。它们遵循仓库中的自主工程实践，如代理指令和技能。持续集成和预览部署在角色间设置关卡，未通过关卡的工单会返回给构建者并附上原因。

安排维护任务，例如每周的依赖项升级。管理拉取请求的预览环境以及代理使用的MCP服务器。

通过OAuth登录，或发送SHIP个人访问令牌。绑定到单个项目的令牌只能访问该项目的任务。

您需要SHIP账户和已连接的GitHub仓库。在https://letsship.ai创建账户。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: File a mission from an issue or a description, Follow a mission through plan, build, review and test, Send instructions to the agent that runs next, Read test traces, screenshots and session logs, Schedule maintenance missions

payload.name: AI Interpretation Layer Audit™
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: AI Interpretation Layer Audit™ Public 1.0.0 assesses ten public structural resources on a user-supplied domain. It reports detected resources, the backend technical score and level, and a separate server-generated interpretation assessment with findings, impact and neutral recommendations. Reports follow the requested language. The tool is read-only: it does not modify websites, generate or publish resources, or perform purchases or payments. Detection does not validate ILID, SHA-256, provenance, content consistency or internal relationships. The audit does not measure actual AI visibility or recommendations, and does not guarantee appearance, ranking or recommendation.
payload.longDescription: AI Interpretation Layer Audit™ Public 1.0.0对用户提供的域名下的十个公开结构化资源进行评估。该工具会报告检测到的资源、后端技术评分和等级，以及由服务器生成的独立解读评估报告，包含发现内容、影响分析和中立建议。报告语言符合用户指定的语言。该工具为只读模式：不会修改网站内容、生成或发布资源，也不执行采购或支付操作。检测过程不验证ILID、SHA-256、来源证明、内容一致性或内部关联性。审计不测量实际AI可见性或推荐内容，且不保证显示效果、排名或推荐结果。

payload.name: ClawMaven
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Work with your saved ClawMaven governance profiles before you deploy an AI agent. Get a profile's posture score, grade, and category breakdown; retrieve the effective policy (allowed tools, blocked domains, budget caps, and autonomy level) for an agent you name; check an agent's USD spend against the profile's budget cap; and generate a signed trust manifest for deployment. Recording monthly spend requires your authorization. ClawMaven is pre-deployment governance design: it does not scan code, monitor agents, or enforce policy at runtime.
payload.longDescription: 在部署AI代理之前，使用您保存的ClawMaven治理配置文件。获取配置文件的立场评分、等级和类别分解；检索您命名的代理的有效策略（允许的工具、被阻止的域名、预算上限和自主级别）；检查代理的美元支出是否超出配置文件的预算上限；并生成用于部署的已签名信任清单。记录月度支出需要您的授权。ClawMaven是预部署治理设计：它不会扫描代码、监控代理或在运行时执行策略。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Posture scores, Effective policy lookup, Per-run budget checks, Monthly spend recording, Signed trust manifests

payload.name: Pabbly Studio
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Pabbly Studio builds and hosts web apps for small businesses. Connect your Pabbly Studio account and ask ChatGPT to create an app, write or change its pages, add photographs, and publish it to its own web address in about a minute.

What you can do:
- Create a new app and build its pages by describing what you want.
- Change any page, form or layout of an existing app, then publish the change as a new version.
- Add stock photographs, or your own logo and images from a link.
- See every version of an app, compare two versions, and roll back.
- Rename an app, or switch its public site off and on again.
- Read an app's recent logs and the data it has stored, to find out why something is not working.

Who it is for: people who build and run their apps on Pabbly Studio and want to work on them from ChatGPT.

Limitations:
- A Pabbly Studio account is required. ChatGPT reaches only the apps of the account you sign in with.
- API keys and passwords for outside services are never entered through ChatGPT. You add them yourself in the app's Environment tab in Pabbly Studio.
- How many apps can be switched on at once depends on your Pabbly Studio account.
- ChatGPT asks before it changes, publishes or removes anything. Deleting an app is permanent and needs the app to be switched off first.
payload.longDescription:
Pabbly Studio为小型企业构建和托管网页应用。连接您的Pabbly Studio账户，让ChatGPT创建应用、编写或修改页面、添加照片，并在约一分钟内发布到独立网址。

您可以：
- 通过描述需求创建新应用并构建页面
- 修改现有应用的任意页面、表单或布局，发布为新版本
- 添加素材照片，或从链接中上传自有Logo和图片
- 查看应用所有版本，对比两个版本并回滚
- 重命名应用，或重新开启/关闭其公开站点
- 查阅应用的近期日志和存储数据，排查问题原因

适用于在Pabbly Studio上构建和运行应用，并希望通过ChatGPT进行操作的用户

限制条件：
- 需要Pabbly Studio账户。ChatGPT仅能访问您登录账户的应用
- 外部服务的API密钥和密码不会通过ChatGPT输入。您需在Pabbly Studio应用的Environment标签页中自行添加
- 同时开启的应用数量取决于您的Pabbly Studio账户类型
- ChatGPT在修改、发布或删除内容前会先询问确认。删除应用为不可逆操作，需先关闭应用

information.value: Create a new web app, Write and change an app's pages, Add stock photos or your own images, Publish a new version in about a minute, Compare versions and roll back, Switch an app's site off or on, Read an app's logs and stored data

payload.name: Layzr
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Use Layzr to audit public websites, retrieve saved reports, and investigate design, copy, SEO, UX, and conversion issues. Ask for an actionable fix, track your progress, and recheck it after making a change.

Connect your existing Layzr account to use the features and allowances included in your subscription. Depending on your account access, Layzr can also check AI visibility and brand mentions, manage website monitoring and custom prompts, and check whether pages are ready for AI agents.

Usage is shared with the Layzr website. You review permissions when connecting and can revoke assistant access from Layzr’s connection settings.
payload.longDescription:
使用Layzr审核公开网站，获取保存的报告，并调查设计、文案、SEO、用户体验和转化率问题。请求可操作的解决方案，跟踪进度，并在更改后重新检查。

连接您的现有Layzr账户以使用订阅包含的功能和权限。根据账户权限，Layzr还可检查AI可见性及品牌提及情况，管理网站监控和自定义提示，并检测页面是否已准备好供AI代理使用。

使用权限与Layzr网站共享。连接时您将审核权限，并可通过Layzr的连接设置撤销助手访问权限。

payload.name: upAPI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
upAPI is an API marketplace: one account and one API key for a catalog of ready-to-use APIs, so a team does not sign up for and wire each service separately. The upAPI plugin brings a focused set of those APIs into ChatGPT.

What it can do:
- Turn a web page you point it at into clean Markdown, or capture a screenshot of it.
- Render HTML you provide into a PDF.
- Extract the text from a PDF, and read the text in an image (OCR).
- Transcribe an audio file, and fetch the finished transcript.
- Look up a public GitHub repository or an npm package: version, licence, stars, links.
- Read a Wikipedia article.
- Convert an amount between currencies at the current rate.

Tools: eleven tools (fetch_markdown_post, screenshot_post, html_to_pdf_post, pdf_extract_text_post, image_ocr_post, audio_transcribe_post, audio_transcribe_result_get, github_repo_get, npm_package_get, wikipedia_article_get, currency_convert_get). None of them looks up people, and none asks for personal information.

Who it is for: developers and teams who already use upAPI and want those APIs inside a conversation.

How it connects: you sign in to upAPI with OAuth 2.1 (PKCE) and approve the connection on upAPI's consent screen. You can revoke the connection at any time from your upAPI settings.

Limitations: files and pages are processed for the request and not kept as documents; extracted text is cached for up to 24 hours and transcripts are kept 24 hours so they can be fetched. The plugin does not send email, post anywhere, process payments or generate media.
payload.longDescription:
upAPI是一个API市场：使用一个账户和一个API密钥即可访问可直接使用的API目录，团队无需分别注册并连接每个服务。
upAPI插件将其中一组精选API引入ChatGPT。

它可以实现以下功能：
- 将您指向的网页转换为干净的Markdown格式，或对其进行截图。
- 将您提供的HTML内容渲染为PDF。
- 从PDF中提取文本，并对图片中的文字进行识别（OCR）。
- 转录音频文件，并获取完成的转录文本。
- 查阅公开的GitHub仓库或npm包：版本、许可证、星标数、链接。
- 阅读维基百科文章。
- 按当前汇率转换金额。

工具：十一个工具（fetch_markdown_post、screenshot_post、html_to_pdf_post、pdf_extract_text_post、image_ocr_post、audio_transcribe_post、audio_transcribe_result_get、github_repo_get、npm_package_get、wikipedia_article_get、currency_convert_get）。
它们都不会查找人员信息，也不会要求提供个人资料。

适用对象：已使用upAPI的开发者和团队，希望在对话中直接调用这些API的人群。

连接方式：您可通过OAuth 2.1（PKCE）登录upAPI，并在upAPI的授权页面上批准连接。
您可随时通过upAPI设置撤销该连接。

使用限制：文件和页面仅用于当前请求的处理，不会作为文档保存；提取的文本会缓存最多24小时，转录文本保存24小时以便后续获取。
该插件不会发送邮件、发布内容、处理支付或生成媒体。

payload.name: Form Backend
payload.description: 代理的表单和电子邮件
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Connect your existing website forms to Jotform directly inside ChatGPT and Codex. Describe what you need to connect your form, collect responses, and set up submission emails while keeping your website’s design.

Key Features:
- Connect existing website forms to a submission backend
- Update backing form fields when your website form changes
- View collected responses and ask AI to summarize them
- Set up email notifications for new submissions
- Configure confirmation emails for people who submit your form
- Customize notification and confirmation email content

Use Form Backend for contact forms, lead capture, feedback, registrations, applications, and internal requests.
payload.longDescription:
将现有网站表单直接连接到ChatGPT和Codex中的Jotform，描述您需要连接表单、收集响应并设置提交电子邮件的需求，同时保持网站设计不变。

核心功能：
- 将现有网站表单连接到提交后端
- 当网站表单更改时更新后端表单字段
- 查看收集的响应并让AI进行总结
- 为新提交设置电子邮件通知
- 为提交表单的人员配置确认邮件
- 自定义通知和确认邮件内容

适用于联系表单、潜在客户获取、反馈收集、注册、申请及内部请求场景。

payload.name: Chapa
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Read public Chapa developer evidence profiles, explain their scores, compare compatible profiles, and generate live badge embeds. Chapa records authorized development activity in policy-labelled receipts. Its core score combines up to 60 activity points with up to 40 points from optional adoption evidence for one product. Delivery, Quality, Consistency and Breadth are activity diagnostics. Optional report-derived Craft is separate and does not change the core score.

Nine public, read-only tools resolve profile links, read the selected receipt and history, compare profiles, explain dimensions and verification, check a supplied badge token, and return Markdown or HTML embeds. The assistant must preserve the returned policy, observation period, freshness and coverage. Profiles require owner sign-up; collection or unavailable states are reported without an invented score. Comparisons can be unavailable when policies or periods differ.

For v7.5 receipts, Craft estimates outcomes among classified sessions and discloses classified coverage; unknown and unclassified sessions are excluded from that estimate. Earlier receipts keep their original rules. Evidence bands are not worldwide rankings or judgments of ability. Adoption counts are analytics identifiers, not verified people, revenue or proof of causal impact. Verification distinguishes recorded issuance, signature authentication and arithmetic replay; it does not independently verify source truth.

No Chapa sign-in is required to use this plugin. It exposes public aggregates, not credentials, private repository identities, raw reports or provider records. Account connections, report uploads and badge configuration changes take place on the Chapa website.
payload.longDescription:
查看公开的Chapa开发者凭证资料，解释其评分，对比兼容资料，并生成实时徽章嵌入代码。
Chapa在政策标签收据中记录授权的开发活动。
其核心评分将最多60分的活动积分与最多40分的单个产品可选采用凭证相结合。
交付质量、一致性及覆盖面是活动诊断指标。
可选的报告衍生工艺指标单独存在，不影响核心评分。

九个公开的只读工具可解析资料链接、读取选定收据及历史记录、对比资料、解释维度与验证信息、检查提供的徽章令牌，并返回Markdown或HTML嵌入代码。
助手必须保留返回的政策条款、观察周期、数据新鲜度和覆盖范围。
资料需要所有者注册；在未收集或不可用状态下会报告但不生成虚构评分。
当政策或周期不同时，对比功能可能不可用。

针对v7.5收据，工艺指标会估算分类会话中的结果并披露分类覆盖范围；未知和未分类会话不包含在该估算中。
早期收据保持原有规则。
凭证区间不代表全球排名或能力评判。
采用统计数是分析标识符，不是经验证的人员、收入或因果影响的证明。
验证区分记录发行、签名认证和算术重放；它不独立验证来源真实性。

使用此插件无需Chapa登录。
它仅展示公开汇总数据，不暴露凭证、私人仓库身份、原始报告或供应商记录。
账户连接、报告上传和徽章配置更改需在Chapa网站进行。

information.label: Capabilities

payload.name: OpsTruth Verification
payload.description: 通过证据验证编码工作
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: OpsTruth Verification inspects public GitHub source and current CI evidence, traces static routes and configuration, and creates signed evidence snapshots. Explicitly supplied public HTTPS checks are bounded, with missing evidence and contradictions kept visible. It does not execute repository code, merge changes, deploy applications or accept private credentials.
payload.longDescription: OpsTruth Verification 会检查公共GitHub源代码和当前持续集成证据，追踪静态路由和配置，并创建签名证据快照。明确提供的公共HTTPS检查是有限的，缺失证据和矛盾之处会保持可见。它不会执行仓库代码、合并更改、部署应用或接受私有凭证。

payload.name: BEON PASS
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: BEON PASS is an access wallet for developer and cloud tools. Connect provider accounts once, then let ChatGPT read resources and take authorized actions across repositories, databases, deployments, infrastructure, and other connected services. BEON PASS keeps personal and organization accounts separate, supports multiple accounts per provider, enforces resource-level permissions, approvals, temporary access, and Autopilot authorization, and never exposes provider credentials or secret values to ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: BEON PASS是开发者和云工具的访问钱包。连接提供商账户一次，即可让ChatGPT跨代码仓库、数据库、部署、基础设施和其他连接服务读取资源并执行授权操作。BEON PASS可分离个人账户与组织账户，支持每个提供商多个账户，强制实施资源级权限、审批流程、临时访问及自动驾驶授权，且从不向ChatGPT暴露提供商凭证或密钥值。

payload.name: SimpleBackups
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
SimpleBackups helps ChatGPT and Codex back up application data before deployments, database migrations, and other changes, diagnose backup failures, and prepare recovery from successful backups.

Run an existing backup with your authorization, check its completion status, identify recent successful recovery points, and retrieve restore links and instructions. Investigate failures using actual run output, review backup history, inspect server and storage inventory, and pause or resume backup schedules. Backup runs, schedule changes, and restore preparation require write permission.

Works with configured database, file, cloud storage, and application backups. Supported sources include Supabase, Neon, PlanetScale, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, GitHub, Notion, Linear, and other SimpleBackups integrations.

Requires an existing SimpleBackups account with MCP access enabled and backups configured in the dashboard. Operations are limited to your connected team and granted permissions. Use a configured backup name or ID to select a resource. A queued backup must complete successfully before it can serve as a recovery point.

Recovery tools prepare access and instructions; they do not execute restores or overwrite databases. Provider onboarding, discovery of unconfigured resources, and deletion are unsupported.
payload.longDescription:
SimpleBackups帮助ChatGPT和Codex在部署、数据库迁移及其他变更前备份应用数据，诊断备份失败情况，并准备从成功备份中恢复的方案。

在获得授权后运行现有备份，检查其完成状态，识别最近成功的恢复点，并获取恢复链接和操作说明。
通过实际运行输出排查失败原因，查看备份历史记录，检查服务器和存储库存清单，并可暂停或恢复备份计划。
备份运行、计划变更和恢复准备操作需要写入权限。

支持配置的数据库、文件、云存储及应用备份。
支持的数据源包括Supabase、Neon、PlanetScale、PostgreSQL、MySQL、MongoDB、GitHub、Notion、Linear以及其他SimpleBackups集成服务。

需要已存在的SimpleBackups账户且已开启MCP访问权限，并在仪表盘中配置好备份。
操作范围仅限于您关联的团队及授权权限。
可通过配置的备份名称或ID选择资源。
排队中的备份必须成功完成后才能作为恢复点。

恢复工具仅提供访问权限和操作说明；不执行实际恢复操作或覆盖数据库。
供应商接入、未配置资源发现及删除操作不被支持。

payload.name: ThunderPhone
payload.summaryOriginal: Build and run AI phone agents
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: ThunderPhone builds, tests and runs AI phone agents. From ChatGPT or Codex you can create an agent from a plain-language brief, attach a phone number, add knowledge documents, generate and run test conversations, and review call results. Every action is scoped to the ThunderPhone organization you authorize with OAuth. Billable or irreversible actions, such as placing calls, starting campaigns or deleting an agent, ask for your confirmation first. No tool asks for passwords, API keys or payment details.

payload.name: DNS Doctor - DNS & DMARC Tools
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Check, fix and verify any domain's DNS, explained in plain English. DNS Doctor reads the records behind a domain, tells you what is wrong and why, and gives you the exact record to publish when there is one.

Scan a domain for email authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC), mail routing (MX), DNS health, blacklists and domain and SSL certificate expiry. Look up any record on the domain's own nameservers, see whether a change has reached resolvers in six locations, check reverse DNS for a mail server, count SPF lookups, audit the third-party includes an SPF record trusts, and read a domain's registration: registrar, expiry, nameservers and locks.

DMARC records are generated and validated by a deterministic engine that follows the RFCs. The AI writes the explanation, never the record. SPF is diagnosed but never rewritten, because a changed SPF record can silently cut off a real sender. Nothing is applied to your DNS: you publish every record yourself.

Connect your DNS Doctor account to work with your monitored domains from ChatGPT: add a domain, check its ownership record, and read the alerts DNS Doctor raises for record changes, expiry, blacklisting, registrar or nameserver changes and new email senders seen in DMARC reports. It also tells you when that report evidence says it is safe to move DMARC from none to quarantine and then to reject.
payload.longDescription:
用通俗易懂的中文检查、修复并验证任何域名的DNS。DNS Doctor会读取域名背后的记录，告诉你哪里出错以及原因，并在有需要时提供要发布的具体记录。

扫描域名的邮件认证（SPF、DKIM、DMARC）、邮件路由（MX）、DNS健康状况、黑名单以及域名和SSL证书到期情况。可查询域名自有DNS服务器上的任意记录，查看变更是否已到达六个地区的解析器，检查邮件服务器的反向DNS，统计SPF查询次数，审计SPF记录信任的第三方包含项，并查看域名的注册信息：注册商、到期时间、DNS服务器和锁定状态。

DMARC记录由遵循RFC标准的确定性引擎生成并验证。AI会撰写解释说明，但不会直接生成记录。SPF会进行诊断但不会被重写，因为修改SPF记录可能无声地切断真实发件人。您的DNS不会被任何改动：所有记录需您自行发布。

将DNS Doctor账户连接至ChatGPT，即可在其中管理监控的域名：添加域名、检查所有权记录，并查看DNS Doctor针对记录变更、到期、黑名单、注册商或DNS服务器变更以及DMARC报告中出现的新发件人所发出的警报。它还会告知您何时报告证据显示可将DMARC策略从无（none）逐步调整为隔离（quarantine）最终到拒绝（reject）。

- Identify winning and fatigued Meta creatives, compare audiences and placements, and investigate delivery, pixel, catalog, or product-feed issues.
- Diagnose GA4, consent, attribution, conversion-tracking, and funnel problems, including differences between advertising platforms and GA4.
- Troubleshoot Merchant Center disapprovals, product-feed problems, weak Shopping visibility, price competitiveness, and underperforming products.
- Investigate website and organic-search traffic declines, audit landing pages, plan campaign tests, and prepare reports for business owners or clients.

Solutions
For eCommerce shops and SMBs, HYPD connects all important marketing data and turns it into clear answers about budgets, results, and next steps. eCommerce shops can also investigate product-feed issues, Shopping performance, customer journeys, and revenue attribution.

For agencies and freelancers, HYPD helps analyze multiple client accounts, explain performance changes, uncover optimization opportunities, and prepare client-ready reports.

payload.name: RocketReach
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect RocketReach so you can find and verify professional contact data from a single conversation. Search across 700M+ professionals worldwide to surface key decision makers, then look them up to reveal verified emails, phone numbers, and social profiles. Enrich contacts and companies with details like funding, headcount, growth, and tech stack, and build targeted lists for sales, marketing, and recruiting, all without leaving the chat.

payload.name: Supermetrics Marketing Agent
payload.description: 分析数据，管理广告活动
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Connect ChatGPT to Google Ads, Meta (Facebook & Instagram) Ads, TikTok Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Microsoft Advertising, GA4 and 200+ marketing sources with Supermetrics — to both analyze your data and take action on your campaigns.

Beyond reporting, you can create, edit and optimize campaigns across Google Ads, Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn and Microsoft Advertising directly from chat — adjust budgets and bids, pause or launch campaigns, update targeting and manage creatives.

The Supermetrics MCP server gives secure, real-time access so you can ask for things like:

 - "How did our Google Ads campaigns perform last month vs the month before?"
 - "Pause every campaign with a cost per conversion above €50."
 - "Reallocate budget to my highest-performing campaigns."
 - "Launch a new Meta campaign targeting our retargeting audience."
 - "Compare cost per conversion across Meta, TikTok and LinkedIn this quarter."
 - "Which campaigns are wasting spend right now — and cut their budgets 20%."
 
Works with the ad, analytics, CRM and e-commerce platforms your team already uses, including Google Search Console, Shopify, Klaviyo, HubSpot, Salesforce, Amazon Ads, Pinterest, Snapchat and Reddit Ads.
 
Built on Supermetrics' trusted data infrastructure, this integration ensures accurate, governed, and up-to-date marketing data — and safe, controlled campaign changes — inside ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription:
通过Supermetrics将ChatGPT连接至Google Ads、Meta（Facebook及Instagram）广告、TikTok广告、LinkedIn广告、微软广告、GA4以及200多个营销数据源，即可对数据进行分析并直接操作广告活动

除了基础报告功能，您还可以通过聊天直接在Google Ads、Meta、TikTok、LinkedIn和微软广告平台上创建、编辑和优化广告活动——调整预算和出价、暂停或启动广告、更新定向设置并管理广告素材

Supermetrics MCP服务器提供安全的实时访问权限，您可以查询以下内容

- "我们的Google Ads广告活动上个月的表现与前一个月相比如何？"
- "暂停所有每次转化成本超过50欧元的广告活动。"
- "将预算重新分配给当前表现最佳的广告活动。"
- "启动一个新的Meta广告活动，定向我们的再营销受众群体。"
- "对比本季度Meta、TikTok和LinkedIn的每次转化成本。"
- "目前哪些广告活动在浪费预算——将它们的预算削减20%。"

兼容团队已使用的广告、分析、客户关系管理（CRM）和电子商务平台，包括Google搜索控制台、Shopify、Klaviyo、HubSpot、Salesforce、亚马逊广告、Pinterest、Snapchat及Reddit广告

基于Supermetrics可信赖的数据基础设施构建，该集成确保在ChatGPT内实现精准、受管控且实时更新的营销数据——以及安全可控的广告活动修改操作。

payload.name: Attio
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Attio connects ChatGPT directly to your CRM workspace, letting you manage customer relationships through natural conversation. 

Search and filter contacts, companies, and deals with flexible queries. Create, update, and organize records without switching between screens. Add notes, manage tasks, and track your sales pipeline—all through simple requests. 

Key capabilities: 
- Search records using powerful filters (find companies by size, industry, last contact date) 
- Create and update people, companies, and deal records 
- Manage notes attached to any record 
- Track and complete tasks 
- Navigate lists and organize your data 

Whether you're preparing for a meeting, updating deal stages, or researching prospects, Attio brings your CRM data into your conversation — no manual data entry required.
payload.longDescription:
Attio 将 ChatGPT 直接连接到你的CRM工作区，让你通过自然对话管理客户关系。

使用灵活查询搜索和筛选联系人、公司及交易。无需切换屏幕，即可创建、更新和整理记录。通过简单请求添加笔记、管理任务并跟踪销售机会管道。

- 使用强大的筛选条件搜索记录（按规模、行业、最后联系日期查找公司）

- 管理附加到任何记录的笔记
- 跟踪并完成任务
- 浏览列表并整理数据

无论你在准备会议、更新交易阶段还是研究潜在客户，Attio 都能将CRM数据带入对话——无需手动录入数据。

payload.name: Close
payload.description: 通过 ChatGPT 使用 Close CRM
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Close stores every call, email, SMS, and meeting your team touches, not just contact records. Connect it to ChatGPT and your conversation history becomes something you can actually work from.

Ask ChatGPT to catch you up on a deal, summarize recent calls, draft follow-ups, update records, or build outreach workflows without bouncing between tools. Close is built around communication. Calls, emails, SMS, and meetings are all logged and searchable, giving ChatGPT far more context than traditional CRMs built mostly for record-keeping.

Close also includes Chloe, a built-in AI sales teammate embedded directly into your workflows. Together, ChatGPT and Chloe help teams stay on top of follow-up, prioritize outreach, and keep deals moving.
payload.longDescription:
Close 会保存团队参与的每次通话、邮件、短信和会议记录，而不仅仅是联系人记录。将它连接到 ChatGPT 后，你的对话历史就能真正用于工作。

你可以让 ChatGPT 帮你快速了解一笔交易、总结近期通话、起草跟进内容、更新记录或构建外联工作流，无需在不同工具之间来回切换。Close 围绕沟通构建。通话、邮件、短信和会议都会被记录并可供搜索，因此 ChatGPT 能获得比主要用于记录信息的传统 CRM 丰富得多的上下文。

Close 还包含内置的 AI 销售伙伴 Chloe，直接嵌入你的工作流。ChatGPT 与 Chloe 协同，帮助团队跟进后续事项、确定外联优先级并推动交易进展。
